scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('./dist', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('./src/managed')) fs.cpSync('./src/managed', './dist/managed', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('./src/dice.compact', './dist/dice.compact');"
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
